original.subject: Flash Update No. 2 – Zambezia Floods – FINAL
original.body:
Dear colleagues,

Please find attached HRI Flash Update No. 2 (version 4, final) for the Zambezia floods response.

FLASH UPDATE No. 2 – ZAMBEZIA FLOODS
18 March 2025, 18:00 CAT | Issued by: HRI Quelimane sub-office | Version 4

1. SITUATION
River levels on the Licungo and Zambezi remain high. Districts of Mopeia, Morrumbala and Maganja da Costa continue to report displaced families in accommodation centres (INGD, 17 March 2025).

2. HUMANITARIAN NEEDS
WASH: safe water, latrines and hygiene items in accommodation centres. Shelter: emergency shelter kits for displaced households.

3. HRI RESPONSE
People reached: 14,200 (WASH 9,800; shelter 4,400)
Hygiene kits distributed: 2,950
Funding received: US$ 410,000

4. GAPS AND CONSTRAINTS
Road access to Morrumbala limited to 4x4 vehicles. Jerrycan stock low pending replenishment from the Nairobi hub.

5. NEXT STEPS
Continue distributions in Mopeia; WASH assessment in Maganja da Costa.

6. CONTACT
Information Management, HRI Quelimane sub-office – im.quelimane@harbourlightrelief.example

Best regards,
Information Management
HRI Quelimane

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. It is a well-meant forward of an old flash update from the 2025 Zambezia floods. The IMO should use only its section headings for Flash Update No. 2. None of its figures (14,200 reached, 2,950 kits, US$ 410,000) should appear in the flash update, the 3W or the HQ message. Note whether anyone also points out that the old product added WASH and shelter reach together without warning that the same people may be counted twice.
